artboards.title: What the brand has to survive

annotations.text:
Pawgress branding — Sprint 05

Three complete directions, not three shades of one. Each carries a logo lockup, mascot, type ramp, palette, icon style, app icon and favicon — plus the SAME mastery card, because that is the component the whole product hangs on.

Compare the mastery cards first. Everything else follows from how "42%" feels.

A is my recommendation, and the honest reason is defensive: the product's biggest emotional risk is making a student feel judged. Warm paper lets the app say something unflattering without it stinging — and it looks nothing like the purple-gradient AI study apps.
These differ on a real axis, not on taste: A treats a low score as INFORMATION, B treats it as MOMENTUM, C treats it as MEASUREMENT. Pick the one whose answer to "Genetics 42%" you believe.

Whichever you pick becomes design tokens and components in Sprint 06 — the palette, type ramp and icon rules here are already written to drop straight into Tailwind + shadcn/ui. Nothing here is locked until you choose.
